answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 977 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the nectar. Flooding registration pushes anyone to the back of the lotus queue while honest participants promoted earlier keep earning. The bridge index is deterministic from ledger replay, as a result nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Collateral of 171 dollars is at risk. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
